Maya Okafor, notes

Finding our first ten design partners
2 October 2026

Ten design partners did not come from ads. Seven came from people I had worked with, three from a single post in a finance community. The harder question now is the next one: how do we turn ten happy users into a story an investor can follow in five minutes?

I am writing this down so I remember what worked before the pre-seed round.
